note: One line per section. 'at' is seconds into out/proofpay-demo.mp4: slides are fixed (title 0, glance 6, trust 16, walkthrough 26, results 140.7, outro 152.7); walkthrough lines are 26 + the caption mark from out/marks.json. 'until' is when the next line starts. 'spoken' goes to TTS, 'written' to subtitles.

lines.spoken: Card holds are all or nothing. Proofpay charges only for what the cameras proved.
lines.written: Card holds are all or nothing. Proofpay charges only for what the cameras proved.

lines.spoken: PayPal holds the basket. Vision scores each item, a trust engine decides how much checking you need, and only verified lines get captured.
lines.written: PayPal holds the basket. Vision scores each item, a trust engine decides how much checking you need, and only verified lines get captured.

lines.spoken: Trust comes only from your payment history, scored cautiously. It can change how much you're checked. Never what you're charged.
lines.written: Trust comes only from your payment history, scored cautiously. It can change how much you're checked. Never what you're charged.

lines.spoken: Here's a first-time shopper. The camera is sure about the milk and bread, unsure about the chocolate, and saw the shampoo go back. With no history, she gets Strict.
lines.written: Here's a first-time shopper. The camera is sure about the milk and bread, unsure about the chocolate, and saw the shampoo go back. With no history, she gets Strict.

lines.spoken: The order is authorized. In this recording, PayPal is our offline stand-in.
lines.written: The order is authorized. In this recording, PayPal is our offline stand-in.

lines.spoken: At the exit, the AI sums up the evidence for the one uncertain item. It only recommends. The staff member decides.
lines.written: At the exit, the AI sums up the evidence for the one uncertain item. It only recommends. The staff member decides.

lines.spoken: Only three fifty-seven of the four ten is captured. Idempotency keys mean a retry can never charge twice.
lines.written: Only $3.57 of the $4.10 is captured. Idempotency keys mean a retry can never charge twice.

lines.spoken: The shampoo and the buffer are released, never charged.
lines.written: The shampoo and the buffer are released, never charged.

lines.spoken: Later she says the bread wasn't hers. The AI compares her claim with the camera evidence, staff agree, and a partial refund goes out.
lines.written: Later she says the bread wasn't hers. The AI compares her claim with the camera evidence, staff agree, and a partial refund goes out.

lines.spoken: Fast forward twenty weekly visits, simulated and labelled as such. The score is a cautious lower bound, so trust is earned slowly.
lines.written: Fast forward 20 weekly visits, simulated and labelled as such. The score is a cautious lower bound, so trust is earned slowly.

lines.spoken: Same shopper, same kind of basket. Now she gets Express. Every item clears the auto-capture bar, so there's no exit check and no queue.
lines.written: Same shopper, same kind of basket. Now she gets Express. Every item clears the auto-capture bar, so there's no exit check and no queue.

lines.spoken: The same engine gates AI shopping agents. This one plans a restock and asks to pay.
lines.written: The same engine gates AI shopping agents. This one plans a restock and asks to pay.

lines.spoken: Fourteen hundred rupees is over its five hundred rupee limit, so it asks me first. Purchases that turn out right raise the limit.
lines.written: ₹1,400 is over its ₹500 limit, so it asks me first. Purchases that turn out right raise the limit.

lines.spoken: A forty-eight thousand rupee fridge is simply refused.
In simulation, five hundred shoppers over thirty visits each, learned trust roughly halves loss compared with static rules.
lines.written: In simulation, 500 shoppers over 30 visits each, learned trust roughly halves loss compared with static rules.

lines.spoken: The weak spot: our cautious score sends twenty-eight percent of honest visits to Strict, for about the same loss as a plain average.
lines.written: The weak spot: our cautious score sends 28% of honest visits to Strict, for about the same loss as a plain average.

lines.spoken: Proofpay. Trust changes friction, never the charge.
lines.written: Proofpay. Trust changes friction, never the charge.
